spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact declaration CSS.supports('color', 'color(display-p3-linear 1 0 0)'), applies it, reads back getComputedStyle serialization, and reproduces the spec's §10.5 equivalence pair verbatim.

interactive.rationale: Three component sliders rebuild the declaration and repaint three comparison swatches live; a button applies the spec pair and prints both computed values.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises sliders, the CSS.supports probe, computed readback and the spec pair — all present.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch renders a hatched not-painted swatch with the failed probe named (never a lookalike colour), and the long-supported srgb-linear sibling keeps the linear-light concept demonstrable on pre-144 browsers.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5162372125818880 and CSS Color 4 §10.5 plus siblings.

conformance.rationale: Suite assertions color-fn-accepts-display-p3-linear and computed-style-preserves-space encode this page's exact contract; suite verified executing on the /conformance/ route (0 pass / 7 fail on Chromium 141 — the honest pre-144 shape).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): autorun DOM shows the false probe result, the NOT-painted linear swatch, computed display-p3 and srgb-linear values; desktop and 360-mobile screenshots read; CDP shows no page console errors and no horizontal overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts css-display-p3-linear-supported or the explicit -unsupported-fallback on load, syntax-swatches-updated per slider change, and spec-pair-painted/-fallback per pair run.

design_system.rationale: Design-token chrome throughout; the raw colour values under test are the demo's subject, not UI chrome; dark buttons set background and color together; explicit focus-visible outlines.

accessibility.rationale: Sliders are native range inputs in visible mono labels with live value text, swatches have role=img aria-labels, readouts are aria-live, the support banner is role=status, and unsupported states are text plus hatching, not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Swatch grid uses auto-fit minmax so it stacks at 360px; CDP-measured scrollWidth equals innerWidth at 360x740 DPR3; both class screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify the computed serialization on a Chrome 144 build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 the computed-value round trip could only be verified for display-p3 and srgb-linear. On a 144+ browser, confirm getComputedStyle serializes the applied declaration as color(display-p3-linear r g b) with the space keyword preserved, and that the two spec-pair chips are visually identical.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates for visual state changes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose visually-changing output through text equivalents and use native inputs with real labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All swatch changes are mirrored in an aria-live mono readout printing the exact computed values; sliders are native range inputs with visible R/G/B labels and value text.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing (auto-fit/minmax) so comparison grids reflow instead of overflowing.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The three-swatch row is grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)), verified reflowing to a single column at 360px.

summary: Canonical-surface concept for CSS display-p3-linear: exact-declaration probe, live slider-built colour with gamma twin and srgb-linear sibling, computed-style readback, and the spec's own equivalence pair. Honest hatched unsupported state on pre-144 browsers. Verified in headless Chromium 141 at both device classes with clean console.
